Name: Mermaid Farmer
Author: Threeshades
Description:
This mod turns the female farmer sprite into a mermaid, resting and moving around on her fish tail. Now you might ask, why would a mermaid crawl around on land and start a farm? - I dunno, perhaps it seemed more "real" than city life.

The mod affects both your existing female characters and new ones you create. The color of your tail is determined by the pants color you choose in character creation.


------------------------------------

[color=#ffff00]POSSIBLE BUGS:[/color]

The mod has not been completely tested yet because I have not actually played the game very far, so I haven't seen it in action on all animations.

If you see something strange, like the tail being displaced in relation to the upper body, or phantom pixels appearing above or to the side of the character, please let me know, and also tell me what animation the character was doing and which direction she was facing.
